newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean trade gap widens to $487 million October.
newsitem.headline: Chilean trade gap widens to $487 million October.

text.p: Chile's trade deficit climbed to $487.1 million trade deficit last month from $129 million in the same month last year, mainly on a surge in imports, the Central Bank reported.
Imports rose to $1.68 billion in October from $1.48 billion in the same month last year and $1.25 billion in September, the Central Bank said in its biweekly macroeconomic report.
Exports slipped to $1.19 billion from $1.36 billion in October last year, compared to $1.07 billion in September, the bank reported.
The bank is due to release details of the Chilean trade balance later.
